scenes.narration: The project is at risk. The beta slips two weeks because the data import is blocked. Everything else is on track.

visual.heading: Status
visual.text: Beta slips two weeks: the data import is blocked

scenes.narration: Since last week we shipped the login redesign and the new settings page. Both are live for all users.
The numbers moved the right way. Open bugs fell from 18 to 11, and weekly active users grew from 1200 to 1350.
Two things are moving. The reporting screen is in review, owned by Sam, and expected Friday. The audit log starts Monday.
One blocker and one slipped date. The data import waits on the vendor's export format, and only the vendor can unblock it. Because of that, the beta moves from May fifth to May nineteenth.
Next week we finish the reporting screen. The ask: please chase the vendor for the export format this week.
